name: ghost-v5-on-heroku
description: Deploy latest ghost v5 on Heroku
author: thelovekesh <hi@thelovekesh.com>

scripts.postinstall: node bin/install-ghost.mjs && yarn install --cwd ghost && bash bin/aws-s3.sh && mkdir -p content/adapters && rm -rf content/adapters/cloudinary && cp -R node_modules/ghost-storage-cloudinary content/adapters/cloudinary
